MemoryPeak_property_source: systemd's MemoryPeak property -- BE 74 measured that this, read after the unit exits, is NOT the run's peak

retention_state_MEASURED.why: the window's start advances; a state named once and re-quoted later is stale. This run's lines (05:33:59, 05:34:04) are inside the window AT THIS READING and a later reader must not assume so -- which is why they are copied above rather than cited

journal_copy.the_payload_line_verbatim: 2026-09-06: PRE_READ_VERIFIED -- POPULATION RECOMPUTED THROUGH BE'S STRUCTURE: AGREES, sealed=True, economics read: NONE (verification of the economics=False)
journal_copy.why_reconciles: 1 payload line + 1 manager Started line = 2, and `-u da117book06.service` returns 2. A copy returning 0 where -u has lines would be a REFUSAL of the copy, never a record (R-641)

resolved_kind: VERDICT by name: the run's own verdict is affirmative: PRE_READ_VERIFIED on the pre-read path, or IS_A_VERIFICATION_OF_THE_ECONOMICS on the full read

the_five_fields_at_launch.why: SubState is the discriminator: `running` at launch and `exited` at the capture, both loaded/active with ExecMainStatus 0 -- which is why the launch reading is NOT an outcome

the_leaf_sampler_took_no_sample_and_says.what_would_have_been_lost: nothing here: a released leaf cannot be read afterwards, and the in-run read is the peak of record for this unit
the_leaf_sampler_took_no_sample_and_says.why: the external sampler polls every 2 s and the run lived about 5 s: its first tick found the unit already `exited`. The LEAF READ in this capture is therefore the one the RUN ITSELF took from inside, at the end, before the cgroup was released -- not a sample this capture took

wall.source: the manager's Started line and the payload's own line, both from the journal copy above
wall.why_not_computed_here: a duration is read from the two stamps, never estimated

why_copied_while_loaded: rule 20: a reading taken while LoadState=loaded is a reading; after the unit is collected `systemctl show` returns DEFAULTS and the copy would be VOID whatever its strings say. The InvocationID is non-empty here, which is the other half of that test
why_mapped_by_exists: REV 81 S2: the mapping's provenance was IMPLIED. A reader had to infer whether a kind came from the producer's own block or from the map's runtime_default; now it is stated, with the head it was resolved in named by {path, sha256}
